pageTitle: cy Extra support during your case
heading: cy Extra support during your case
guidance: cy Some people need support to access information and use our services. We call this a reasonable adjustment. Some reasonable adjustments need to be agreed by the judge or HMCTS. You can discuss with the tribunal if your needs change.

reasonableAdjustments.option1: cy documents in alternative formats, colours and fonts
reasonableAdjustments.option2: cy help with communicating, sight, hearing, speaking and interpretation
reasonableAdjustments.option3: cy access and mobility support if you attend a hearing in person
